_comment: Legacy About transform FX (removed from Three.js). Bake into Blender with about_site_fx_blender.py, then re-export AboutUsModel.glb. Site scrubs all GLB clips only.

heartScale._note: aboutHeartScale.js — restQuat * axisAngle(axis, angle * smoothstep(smoothstep(t))). Shared Heart* parent preferred.

pcbYaw._note: Site white PCB particles (aboutInsideParticles) use fixed local yaw. Script keys Empty AboutPcbYaw; parent procedural art to it in Blender if you want mesh parity. Particles on site stay until you rebuild them.

frontAdvance._note: aboutFrontAdvance.js — toward camera in parent-local space.

backRetreat._note: aboutBackRetreat.js — away from camera in parent-local space.

outerCellScatter._note: aboutOuterCellScatter.js + ABOUT_MATERIALS.outerCellScatter. Hash/dirs match the site.
